pages.text: When the Pestilence reaches its last phase, at nightfall, $(4)the Pale Rider$() comes. Its bell fills all who hear it with Dread; its arrows carry the Rot; it rides down those who stand close and calls up its Heralds as it weakens.$(br2)Bring the full garb. Bring Theriac. Bring friends.$(br2)Kill it, and the Pestilence breaks entirely.
